purpose: Reconstruct the broker-causal TP/SL order schedule for the frozen 251 ACTUAL_AFTER_COST episodes before any exit counterfactual is evaluated.

ordering_contract.replacement: cancel transaction must precede its replacement create transaction
ordering_contract.terminal: state immediately before TRADE_CLOSED is the executable protection state; LINKED_TRADE_CLOSED cancels at or after terminal do not alter that pre-terminal state

split: feature_at_utc chronological 60/40, floor cut, close-time purge, one-hour embargo; schedule reconstruction never reads outcome values
admission_gates: all 251 episode trade_id values are unique
raw event time and ids are internally consistent
replacement old/new/cancel transaction links are exact
no protection create used before fill or after close
at most one active TP and one active SL per trade
terminal protection order, when present, matches the active order immediately before close

failure_policy.normalized_raw_conflict: raw broker transaction wins only when its own exact links validate; conflict remains reported

downstream_boundary.allowed_after_pass: body/wick and first-touch replay on exact active intervals
